naming.upgrade.kept: kept the project names the scope gave: [workspace] namespace = "{namespace}" is added (the workspace is named "{name}", so new projects would be {fromName}-core, not {fromNamespace}-core)
naming.doctor.check: every package name starts with the workspace namespace
naming.doctor.problem: the package {package} does not start with the namespace {namespace}
naming.doctor.remedy.fix: rename the package to {expected}: smith doctor --fix shows the edit and asks first. Or keep the name and accept this warning in smith.toml ([[doctor.accept]]).
naming.doctor.remedy.dependents: rename the package to {expected} in its manifest and in {dependents}, which depend on it. Or keep the name and accept this warning in smith.toml ([[doctor.accept]]).
naming.doctor.remedy.manual: rename the package to {expected} in its manifest. Or keep the name and accept this warning in smith.toml ([[doctor.accept]]).
